quote: Do not carry the heavy weight of yesterday. It only breaks the back of tomorrow. Every sorrow demands a heavy toll from your soul. You cannot outrun the shadows in your mind. Peace arrives when you finally lay down the burden. Only empty hands can hold the light of today.
